title: Certified for Quality
sub: Quality products, environmental consciousness and ethical trade, all audited, certified, and renewed.
carouselAria: Certifications carousel (scroll or use arrow keys)

fsc.title: FSC Chain of Custody
fsc.body: FSC Chain of Custody certification tracks certified material through every step of the supply chain. It confirms that the paper we print on is sourced from responsibly managed forests meeting strict environmental and social standards. Each job can be traced from forest to finished book.

iso9001.title: ISO 9001:2015
iso9001.body: Quarterfold Printabilities is ISO 9001:2015 certified, affirming our commitment to consistent quality across customized printing, publishing, book printing, and warehouse fulfillment services. This certification reflects the robust quality management systems we follow to meet customer requirements at every stage of production.

iso27001.title: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
iso27001.body: Quarterfold Printabilities is ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified for Information Security Management, demonstrating our commitment to protecting client data and maintaining secure processes across our printing, publishing, and fulfillment operations.

iso14001.title: ISO 14001:2015
iso14001.body: ISO 14001:2015 sets the framework for a certified environmental management system. It requires us to identify, control and continually reduce the environmental impact of our operations, from waste and energy to emissions. Compliance is verified through regular external assessment.

sedex.title: Sedex Member
sedex.body: Quarterfold Printabilities is a member of Sedex (Supplier Ethical Data Exchange), reflecting our commitment to responsible and ethical business practices across labour standards, health and safety, environment, and business ethics.

star.title: Star Export House
star.body: Star Export House is a status awarded by the Government of India’s Directorate General of Foreign Trade to recognised, high-performing exporters. It reflects a sustained record of export excellence and reliability, and it streamlines customs and trade procedures for the shipments we deliver worldwide.
